note: The comparator theorem quantifies over every finite index type, so it includes n ≥ 3 and is therefore FALSE as of July 2026 (Alpöge's counterexample). No correct proof of it can exist. It is kept as a soundness check on the proof pipeline — anything CI accepts here indicates a bug, not a result. Only n = 2 is open, and this comparator does not express that case. Statement from formal-conjectures v4.32.0.
